target.title: improve(mattermost): restart only the changed account on config reload
target.body:
Related: #99311

## What Problem This Solves

On Mattermost gateways running multiple accounts, any config change scoped to a
single account can restart the whole Mattermost channel. On a 9-account Mattermost gateway, each
account-scoped write disconnected and reconnected every account for 1.0–2.6s and
inflated `config.patch` latency 3–4× during the restart window.

## Why This Change Was Made

The reload plan now supports an explicit channel-plugin capability,
`reload.accountScopedRestart`. Only plugins that guarantee account configuration is
isolated may opt in; Mattermost does. Channels such as Telegram and WhatsApp retain
wholesale restart semantics because sibling-account count, inheritance, or credential
ownership can affect an otherwise unchanged account.

For an opted-in channel, changes confined to
`channels.{kind}.accounts.{accountId}[.*]` restart only those `(channel, accountId)`
pairs through the existing `stopChannel` / `startChannel` account parameter. A
channel-global path, `accounts.default.*`, or an account id not listed by the plugin
promotes the channel to a wholesale restart. A channel already scheduled wholesale
drops its account targets, so work is not duplicated.

Per-account restarts preserve the wholesale path's lifecycle invariants: non-manual
stops, active-work deferral, abort-generation checks, failure aggregation with recovery,
and starts outside the config-reload root-work admission. Plugin account-enumeration
errors after config commit request a managed recovery restart instead of leaving new
config paired with stale runtime state. `secrets.reload` has no account-level lifecycle
path, so it continues restarting the whole affected channel.

## User Impact

Mattermost operators running multi-account or multi-tenant gateways no longer see every
account disconnect when one isolated account is added or changed. An account-scoped
reload completes in 0.2–0.7s and touches only that account. Other channel plugins keep
their existing wholesale behavior unless they explicitly prove isolation and opt in.
Single-account deployments see equivalent behavior.

## Evidence

- Red-to-green regression proof for root-work admission (`[0]` before, `[1]` after)
- Opt-in planner coverage: Mattermost targets one account; Telegram remains wholesale
- Post-commit account-enumeration failure requests recovery
- Removed/non-canonical accounts promote to wholesale restart
- Failure aggregation, safe-mode suppression, plugin reload, active-work deferral, and
  `secrets.reload` fallback coverage
- 318 exact-head focused tests green across reload planning/execution and the Mattermost plugin
- Fresh full-branch automated review found no actionable findings (0.89 confidence)

| | wholesale (before) | per-account Mattermost (after) |
|---|---|---|
| restarts per account-add | whole channel | 1 account |
| other-account disconnects | all accounts, 1.0–2.6s per add (45 auto-restarts across 9 mounts) | none |
| reload completion | 0.45–1.5s | 0.18–0.7s |
| `config.patch` latency during reload | 3.3–4.9s worst | ≤2.4s worst |
| failures | none | none |

Before — one Mattermost account's config write restarts everyone:

```
[gateway/channels] restarting mattermost channel
[mattermost] [tester5-coach] auto-restart attempt 1/10 in 5s
[mattermost] [tester25-coach] auto-restart attempt 1/10 in 5s
[mattermost] [tester19-coach] auto-restart attempt 1/10 in 5s
... (all previously connected accounts stop and reconnect)
[mattermost] connected as @tester25-coach   (~2.2s after restart began)
```

After — the same write touches only the changed account:

```
[gateway/channels] restarting mattermost account eck-coach
[reload] config hot reload applied (agents.list, channels.mattermost.accounts.eck-coach)
```

This behavior has also run in production behind our Octogee fork for ~10 weeks across
`2026.5.x → 2026.7.1-beta.1` with no observed per-account-restart incidents.

## Exact-head verification (July 16, 2026)

- Rebased onto current `main` and pushed as `68f4a80ac720887b0863c8bc6300318650495217`
- Added resolver preflight so enumeration failure promotes safely before any target is stopped
- Re-drains any account target that remains live after plugin replacement
- Added explicit plugin-isolation contract documentation and Mattermost sibling-resolution coverage
- Regenerated `docs/docs_map.md`; `pnpm docs:map:check` passes
- Exact-head full-branch automated review: clean (0.89 confidence)

---

AI-assisted (Claude/Codex, supervised): implementation, measurement harness, review,
and write-up were AI-assisted; the change has been human-reviewed and operated in
production by the author. Automated review findings—including stale-account eviction,
default-account inheritance, recovery ownership, active-work deferral, root-work
admission, explicit plugin isolation, and post-commit enumeration failure—were fixed
and covered before requesting review. Happy to adjust anything; first PR here.
